content.comment_body: Is it possible to show the date and time of the last event on the display? For example: Counter: 20 Last Event: 8/9/2015 18:56
A timestamp feature like those found in SCADA or PLC systems isn't available in [product_name]. However, you can create a text message and show the time when the message gets activated.
It's possible to enable diagnostic functions. If [product_name] encounters a network issue or something similar, it can display this information, which will look like a system message for the user.
I don't think the user is referring to diagnostics specifically. Diagnostics are generally intended for troubleshooting.
Here's an example illustrating my point.
I understand your point. If someone wants to record the time of an operation, they will need to manually write it to [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are interested in having the device display the date and time of the most recent event. While native timestamping like in SCADA or PLC systems is not supported in [product_name], the community discusses workarounds such as showing customized text messages or using diagnostic features, though these options require manual intervention and don't completely meet the original request.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the device to include built-in functionality that allows the date and time of the last event to be shown directly on the display.
